tagline: A tiny farm of apps, grown for fun 🌱
dialog: Hey, welcome to Weishen Labs! ようこそ
I'm Wei Shen — accounting & finance by degree, AI tinkerer by obsession.
This is my tiny farm of apps. Nothing's fully grown yet… check back soon! 🌱
The robot farmer does most of the work. You can tip him below ☕🤖

apps.text: Something's planted here. Not even I know what yet.

journal.text: Rebuilt the whole site as a pixel farm 🌱 Hired a robot farmer. His salary? Your tips.
New logo day — the > and the _ now move. Took the GitHub links off too.

paragraphs: By training, I'm an accounting & finance grad. My world was balance sheets, audit trails and numbers that have to tie out perfectly — no surprises allowed.
AI is the complete opposite. It's messy, unpredictable, sometimes confidently wrong… and somehow that's exactly what hooked me. Somewhere between a balance sheet and a prompt box, I fell for it.
So now I live in two worlds: one where everything must balance, and one where I just plant ideas and see what grows. This farm is where the second one lives 🌱
